name: Weekly Report
description: Cron-triggered weekly report flow with Feishu card confirmation, supplement loop, and doc write. v2 adds git-activity fact source.

targetDocToken.description: Feishu doc token where the weekly report is written.

recipientSessionKey.description: Session key where the confirmation card is delivered.

notesDocToken.description: Optional supplementary notes doc the agent may consult.

draftPromptOverride.description: Optional override for the drafting prompt.

sweeperIntervalMs.description: Override for the timeout sweeper tick interval (defaults to 1h).

gitRemotes.description: Repos to track for the git-activity fact source. Empty = git phase disabled.

name.description: Slug for the workspace clone dir (lowercase, hyphens, underscores).

gitAuthor.description: Author pattern passed to `git log --author=`. Required when gitRemotes is non-empty.

gitWorkspaceDir.description: Override for the clone workspace. Default: {state}/weekly-report/repos/.

gitHostAllowlist.description: Allowed hostnames for sshUrls. Default: gitlab.com, github.com.

userOpenId.description: Feishu open_id (ou_...) of the human user; auto-derived from recipientSessionKey's :direct: suffix when unset.

botOpenId.description: Feishu open_id of the bot account; messages with this sender are excluded from group collection. No auto-derivation.

groupDenylist.description: Full sessionKeys or bare chatIds to skip during group collection.

groupStaleAfterDays.description: Skip group sessions with no activity for this many days. Default 14.

topicGroups.description: Handling of Feishu topic-group sub-sessions. include=keep all (default); exclude=dedupe by groupId; collapse-by-chatid deferred to v3.1.
